name: PRL Wallet — Wallet open source di Pearl Hub
shortDescription: Crea wallet · Ripristina il portafoglio esistente · Crittografato localmente · Firmato localmente
detailedDescription:
Crea un portafoglio PRL o ripristinane uno con la frase di ripristino dell'app nativa. Le chiavi sono crittografate su questo dispositivo.

Puoi gestire fino a 10 portafogli.

Si blocca dopo 5 minuti di inattività. Sbloccare nuovamente dopo aver riavviato il browser.

Le frasi di ripristino e le chiavi private non vengono mai inviate al servizio di catena. Dopo aver ripristinato un portafoglio nativo, scansiona le modifiche storiche per controllare i fondi sui vecchi indirizzi.

L'anteprima scade tra 3 minuti. La conferma firma su questo dispositivo, quindi invia la transazione firmata.

La transazione potrebbe essere stata inviata anche se la risposta è andata persa. Controllane lo stato o riprova la stessa transazione.

Ciò elimina solo i record locali. Eseguire prima il backup della frase di recupero. I fondi on-chain non vengono trasferiti automaticamente.

Vengono sincronizzati solo i contatti. Le frasi di recupero, le chiavi private e le password del portafoglio rimangono su questo dispositivo. Gli ingressi con percorsi di indirizzo verificati possono essere firmati. L'individuazione delle modifiche legge solo le transazioni in uscita, con impaginazione e aggiornamenti incrementali.

Verified paths support any non-hardened child index. Manual pathless discovery covers the first 10,000 internal addresses. Sixteen interface languages; 17 secondary currencies. Only PRL Taproot addresses; no independent security audit. Screenshots use simulated public fixtures.

Optional email account login syncs public contacts with Web and native apps. It uses a separate account session; locking or deleting a wallet does not sign out the account. Wallet secrets stay local.

permissionJustifications.storage: Locally stores encrypted wallets, encrypted pending transactions, public contacts and preferences; the trusted session holds the unlock key until lock. No Chrome account sync.
permissionJustifications.alarms: Checks inactivity once per minute to enforce the 5-minute automatic lock.
permissionJustifications.sidePanel: Opens the packaged wallet UI in the browser side panel when its toolbar icon is clicked.
permissionJustifications.https://blockbook.pearlresearch.ai/*: Queries mainnet balances, public account/address history, UTXOs, fees and transaction status; broadcasts only explicitly confirmed locally signed transactions.
Same chain queries and explicitly confirmed broadcasts, restricted to testnet.
permissionJustifications.https://pearlhub.net/*: Public market requests carry no wallet identity. Optional email account login and authenticated configuration sync share contact names, public addresses and notes. Account data is encrypted at rest and readable by the server; wallet seed phrases, private keys and passwords are never uploaded.
permissionJustifications.identity: Opens the Pearl Hub email sign-in page and receives a one-use PKCE authorization callback. Does not read your Google or Microsoft account.

dataUseDisclosure: Financial data: public wallet/account addresses, balances, transaction history and confirmed signed transactions are processed for wallet operation; Blockbook receives chain queries and signed broadcasts. Secret recovery phrases, private keys and passwords stay on-device. Public contact names/addresses/notes and preferences stay local. Market services receive public GET requests without wallet identity; infrastructure can observe IP addresses. Web links pass a public address in the URL fragment only after a user click; the web app may then query it. No analytics, advertising, sale of data, browsing-history collection or Chrome account sync. Do not select “no data used”: financial data is processed even when it stays local or goes only to public indexers. Optional email accounts store email, public contacts and device/session metadata on Cloudflare. Configuration is encrypted at rest; the server can read it. Sign out restores the previous guest contacts. Cloud configuration export and account deletion are available on the account page.
